notes: I replaced the negative-side two-gaussian correction (which was too shallow near x=-0.1 to -1.5, causing E16/E24 mismatches) with a smooth piecewise-linear interpolation of the observed correction curve, anchored to the E24/E16/E20 data and blending to zero by x≈-2.2. The positive side and far-field linear laws are unchanged since they already match.
